listing.name: Pac-Man Championship Edition (Pac-Man Championship Edition (2007): native PC port)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Pac-Man Championship Edition (2007): native PC port; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream describes playable 2007 Championship Edition and random mazes. No independent full-game/platform qualification here. Windows 10/11 Vulkan/D3D12 package; Steam Deck uses Proton, not native Linux. ReXGlue retains Xenia-derived GPU/kernel/audio scope. Upstream platforms: Windows 10/11 with Vulkan or D3D12; x86-64 translation. Steam Deck uses Proton, not a documented native Linux player. Original data: Xbox 360 XBLA Pac-Man Championship Edition 2007 own package or default.xex/media/data. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
